what.text: This page follows refugees from Viet Nam living in China, as UNHCR recorded them from 1979 to 2021.
At the end of 2021, UNHCR counted 303107, 95.4% of all refugees from Viet Nam that year.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between China and Vietnam in several periods from 1974 to 1988, at war level in 1979.
The sources here don't say why people left Viet Nam for China.

when.text: UNHCR's figure stayed between 250000 and 321502 from 1979 to 2021, changing very slowly.
It was highest in 2017 and 2018, and the series stops after 2021.
Returns from China to Viet Nam were highest in 1991 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in China, with no breakdown by gender or age, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
The sources don't say how people travelled, where in China they live or why the series stops after 2021.
